component.name: KataTone
component.summary: Patch editor for the BOSS Katana 50 Gen 3

description.p: KataTone edits the patches of a BOSS Katana 50 Gen 3 amplifier over USB, keeps them in a library of livesets (.tsl files) and writes them back to the amp.
It also has an Analyzer that compares your tone with a reference recording and proposes EQ settings, and a guitar Tuner that checks intonation at the 12th fret.
Available as a Flatpak (the desktop GUI, with the amp over USB).
New Analyzer tools to match a tone to a recording, and a tuner that checks intonation.
